standingScript./root:
set -u
home='/root'; ledger='/root/.wsp/provision/landed'; list='/root/.wsp/provision/asked'

cat > "$list" || exit 1
[ -s "$list" ] || exit 0
cd "$home" || exit 1
xargs -0 sha256sum -z -- < "$list" 2>/dev/null | while IFS= read -r -d "" rec; do
  p=${rec#* }

rm -f "$list"
exit 0

landFilesScript.plain:
set -u
wsp_once() {
  return 1
}
wsp_dest() {
  case "$1" in
    (*) root=$home; sub=$1; top=$home ;;
  esac
  dest="$root/$sub"
}
home='/root'; stage='/root/.wsp/provision/files'; ledger='/root/.wsp/provision/landed'; landing='/root/.wsp/provision/landing'
canon=$(readlink -f -- "$home") || exit 1
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$landing")" || exit 1
: > "$landing" || exit 1
cd "$stage" || exit 1
find . -type f -print | while IFS= read -r p; do
  rel=${p#./}
  src="$stage/$rel"; wsp_dest "$rel"
  s=$(sha256sum "$src" | cut -d" " -f1)
  if [ ! -e "$dest" ] || { [ -f "$dest" ] && [ ! -s "$dest" ]; }; then act=installed
  elif wsp_once "$rel"; then act=present
  else
    d=$(sha256sum "$dest" 2>/dev/null | cut -d" " -f1)
    known=$(wsp_rel="$rel" awk -F"\t" '$1==ENVIRON["wsp_rel"] { print $2" "$3; exit }' "$ledger" 2>/dev/null)
    if [ "$d" = "$s" ]; then act=present
    elif [ -n "$known" ] && [ "$d" = "${known##* }" ]; then
      if [ "$s" = "${known%% *}" ]; then act=present; else act=installed; fi
    else act=kept; fi
  fi
  if [ "$act" = installed ]; then
    mkdir -p "$(dirname "$dest")" && cp -p "$src" "$dest" || act=failed
  fi
  old="$home/$rel"
  if [ "$dest" != "$old" ] && [ "$act" != failed ] && [ -f "$old" ] && [ "$(readlink -f -- "$old")" = "$canon/$rel" ]; then
    was=$(wsp_rel="$rel" awk -F"\t" '$1==ENVIRON["wsp_rel"] { print $3; exit }' "$ledger" 2>/dev/null)
    if [ -n "$was" ] && [ "$(sha256sum "$old" | cut -d" " -f1)" = "$was" ] && rm -f -- "$old"; then
      d=$(dirname "$old"); while [ "$d" != "$top" ] && rmdir -- "$d" 2>/dev/null; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done
    fi
  fi
  printf 'wsp-land\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$act" "$s" "$rel"
  if [ "$act" != kept ] && [ "$act" != failed ] && ! wsp_once "$rel"; then printf "%s\t%s\n" "$rel" "$s" >> "$landing"; fi
done
exit 0

unlandScript.oneDest:
set -u
wsp_dest() {
  case "$1" in
    (*) root=$home; sub=$1; top=$home ;;
  esac
  dest="$root/$sub"
}
home='/root'; ledger='/root/.wsp/provision/landed'
[ -f "$ledger" ] || exit 0
tab=$(printf "\t")
: > "$ledger.new" || exit 1
while IFS="$tab" read -r rel from at; do
  case "$rel" in ('.claude/skills/a'|'.claude/skills/a'/*) ;; (*) printf "%s\t%s\t%s\n" "$rel" "$from" "$at" >> "$ledger.new"; continue ;; esac
  case "/$rel/" in (*/../*) continue ;; esac
  wsp_dest "$rel"
  if [ ! -e "$dest" ] && [ "$dest" != "$home/$rel" ]; then root=$home; sub=$rel; dest="$home/$rel"; fi
  [ -e "$dest" ] || continue
  if [ "$(readlink -f -- "$dest")" = "$(readlink -f -- "$root")/$sub" ] && [ -f "$dest" ] && [ "$(sha256sum "$dest" | cut -d" " -f1)" = "$at" ]; then
    rm -f -- "$dest" && printf 'wsp-unland\tgone\t%s\n' "$rel"
  else
    printf 'wsp-unland\tkept\t%s\n' "$rel"
  fi
done < "$ledger"
mv "$ledger.new" "$ledger" || exit 1
[ "$(readlink -f -- '/root/.claude/skills/a' 2>/dev/null)" = "$(readlink -f -- '/root')/"'.claude/skills/a' ] && find '/root/.claude/skills/a' -depth -type d -empty -delete 2>/dev/null
exit 0

outside.before:
set -u
root=''; prefix="$root/opt/wsp"; ledger="$prefix/landed"
nl=$(printf '\nx'); nl=${nl%x}
tab=$(printf "\t")
at="$prefix/.landing-clis"
[ ! -L "$prefix" ] && mkdir -p "$prefix" 2>/dev/null || exit 0
rm -f "$at".*
states() {
  : > "$1.files"
  while IFS= read -r p; do
    if [ -L "$p" ]; then printf 'link:%s\t%s\n' "$(readlink "$p" | sha256sum | cut -c1-64)" "$p"
    elif [ -d "$p" ]; then printf 'dir\t%s\n' "$p"
    elif [ -f "$p" ]; then printf '%s\000' "$p" >> "$1.files"
    fi
  done
  [ ! -s "$1.files" ] || xargs -0 sha256sum -z -- < "$1.files" | tr '\000' '\n' | awk '{ print substr($0, 1, 64) "\t" substr($0, 67) }'
  rm -f "$1.files"
}
still() {
  find "$root/usr/local" "$root/opt" \( -path "$prefix" -o -path "*$nl*" \) -prune -o -type d -print > "$1.dirs" 2>/dev/null
  wsp_root="$root" wsp_prefix="$prefix" awk -F"\t" 'NR == FNR { d[$0] = 1; next } { s[substr($0, length($1) + 2)] = $1 } END {
    r = ENVIRON["wsp_root"]; px = ENVIRON["wsp_prefix"]
    for (p in s) {
      q = p; sub(/\/[^\/]*$/, "", q)
      if (index(p, r "/usr/local/") != 1 && index(p, r "/opt/") != 1) continue
      if (p == px || index(p, px "/") == 1 || index(p "/", "/./") || index(p "/", "/../") || index(p, "//") || !(q in d)) continue
      print s[p] "\t" p
    }
  }' "$1.dirs" "$ledger" > "$1.latest"
  cut -f2- "$1.latest" | states "$1" > "$1.now"
  awk -F"\t" 'NR == FNR { s[substr($0, length($1) + 2)] = $1; next } { p = substr($0, length($1) + 2); if ((p in s) && s[p] == $1) print }' "$1.latest" "$1.now"
  rm -f "$1.dirs" "$1.latest" "$1.now"
}
: > "$at.mark" || exit 0
find "$root"'/usr/local/bin' "$root"'/opt' "$root"'/usr/local/lib/node_modules' \( -path "$prefix" -o -path "*$nl*" \) -prune -o -print > "$at.before.found" 2>/dev/null
[ $? -lt 128 ] && LC_ALL=C sort "$at.before.found" > "$at.before.part" && echo wsp-listed >> "$at.before.part" && mv "$at.before.part" "$at.before" || { rm -f "$at".*; exit 0; }
if [ -f "$ledger" ] && [ ! -L "$ledger" ]; then
  still "$at.s" | cut -f2- | LC_ALL=C sort -u > "$at.ours.part" && mv "$at.ours.part" "$at.ours"
fi
exit 0
